collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A young singer wants to perform a beautiful song at a festival, but it belongs to another family's tradition.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a young singer, wants to perform a beautiful song at a festival, but it belongs to another family's tradition.

choices.label: Write a New Song Inspired by It.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The family agrees and teaches the singer the proper way.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The family prefers to keep the song private, and the singer chooses another.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The singer performs it with deeper feeling and respect.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The singer realizes the song is meant for mourning and chooses a different one.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The family prefers to sing it alone, and the singer happily listens.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The new song becomes popular, and the family is pleased by the tribute.

d2__fx.name: Outcome D2
d2__fx.text: The new song is not as good, but the singer is proud of it.

d2__text.name: Outcome D2
d2__text.text: The new song is not as good, but the singer is proud of it.
